meta.name: ai-team-orchestration
meta.description: Bootstrap and run a multi-agent AI development team. Use when: starting a new software project with AI agents, setting up parallel dev/QA teams, creating sprint plans, writing brainstorm prompts with distinct agent voices, recovering a project workflow, or planning sprints.

copy.tagline: 启动并运行多智能体AI开发团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用AI智能体组建开发团队并管理项目流程。
copy.tagline_en: Bootstrap and run a multi-agent AI development team
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to set up an AI-powered development team and manage project workflows.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能作为多角色AI团队（如开发、测试、运维等）在独立聊天中协作，你（CEO）传递消息协调进度。
howto.when: 当你开始新软件项目、设置多AI代理团队（开发/QA/DevOps）、创建冲刺计划或从长对话恢复项目进度时触发。

say.text: 启动新项目，请扮演Remy（Producer）制定冲刺计划。
模拟Kira（设计）、Nova（前端）和Sage（后端）进行头脑风暴辩论。
保存当前进度并恢复之前的项目上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a multi-role AI team (e.g., developer, tester, ops) in separate chats, with you (CEO) relaying messages to coordinate progress.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting a new software project, setting up parallel AI agent teams (dev/QA/DevOps), creating sprint plans, or recovering project context from long chats.

say_en.text: Start a new project, act as Remy (Producer) to create a sprint plan.
Simulate a debate between Kira (design), Nova (frontend), and Sage (backend) for brainstorming.
Save current progress and restore previous project context.
